citations.claim: Graph mode returns when the root-motion attribute is missing and the disable flag is enabled.
Graph mode computes stride scale as locomotion speed divided by root-motion speed.
All configured foot bone indices must be present for evaluation.
citations.quote: if (Foot.IKFootBoneIndex == INDEX_NONE || Foot.FKFootBoneIndex == INDEX_NONE || Foot.ThighBoneIndex == INDEX_NONE)

citations.claim: The stride-warping plane origin is found by intersecting gravity from the thigh with the foot floor plane.
citations.quote: const FVector StrideWarpingPlaneOrigin = (FMath::Abs(ResolvedGravityDirection | ResolvedFloorNormal) > DELTA) ? FMath::LinePlaneIntersection(ThighBoneLocation, ThighBoneLocation + ResolvedGravityDirection, IKFootLocation, ResolvedFloorNormal) : IKFootLocation;

citations.claim: The scale origin is the foot projected onto that plane along the stride direction.
The final foot location scales its offset from the scale origin.
citations.quote: const FVector WarpedLocation = ScaleOrigin + (IKFootLocation - ScaleOrigin) * ActualStrideScale;

citations.claim: The node supplies original FK pelvis distances and warped IK locations to the pelvis solver.
The solver averages ideal pelvis positions based on each IK target and FK distance.
citations.quote: const FVector IdealLocation = IKFootLocations[Index] + (PreAdjustmentLocation - IKFootLocations[Index]).GetSafeNormal() * FKFootDistancesToPelvis[Index];

citations.claim: The solver smooths, blends, and caps the pelvis displacement.
Thigh compensation translates the thigh by pelvis offset and rotates it toward the warped target.
FK limits replace an overextended IK target with one at the original FK leg length.
citations.quote: const FVector ClampedFootLocation = AdjustedThighTransform.GetLocation() + TargetDir * FKLength;

citations.claim: The node appends pelvis, thighs, and final IK feet as bone transforms and sorts them.
